t: Section 3(b) of the Emergency Home Purchase Assistance Act of 1974 is amended by striking out “November 1, 1979” and inserting in lieu thereof “December 1, 1979”.

fable.w: This section only extends a statutory date in the Emergency Home Purchase Assistance Act of 1974 by one month. It creates no comment period, hearing, advisory body, consultation with outside parties, rulemaking authority, or right to sue. There is no tempting participation reading because no outside party is involved in any federal decision.
